one_month_reasoning: Window to 2026-12-17. AMAT reported 2026-11-12 (beat, guided Q1 $11.1B above street) and still fell ~6% on target cuts, so the print is behind us and post-beat drift has not shown up. In the window: NVIDIA's results (~Nov 18-19) set AI-capex sentiment for the group; FOMC Dec 8-9; SEMI's year-end equipment forecast at SEMICON Japan (mid-December) and Micron's FQ1 results (~Dec 17, possibly after the window) are memory-capex reads; any new BIS China rule is a tail. No AMAT-specific scheduled event. I stay symmetric around $349 with a 17% one-month sigma (a bit below 64%/3.5 = 18% as the October capitulation volatility fades), median at spot.

reasoning: Primary-lane build. AMAT's Q4 FY26 release and prepared remarks (2026-11-12) give FY26 revenue $34.45B (SS $26.1B, AGS $6.9B), Q1 FY27 guide $11.1B in 14 weeks with SS ~$8.7B, GM ~50.8%, and Dickerson's CY27 WFE '>30%'; Lam's Archer (2026-10-21) independently sets CY26 at mid-$150B and CY27 at >$200B. I book CY27 at $200B (no premium over the two CEO views, below Goldman's Aug 23 $218B), then CY28 +10% and CY29 +3% (moderately conservative per rule 0c; Goldman's +29% for 2028 is the upside case). AMAT capture rises 0.6pt by FY29 (CFO expects to outgrow WFE; haircut to the 2pt-by-2030 target). FY27 SS $35.3B cross-checks to the Q1 guide with output rising every quarter. Company GAAP op margin ~36-37% FY27-28 then ~36% FY29; FY27 GAAP EPS ~$17.7 vs consensus $18.75 (TIKR 2026-11-13, non-GAAP), ~3-4% below on a like basis because of the conservative capture and ramp costs. Guidance record (4 quarters FY26): revenue always inside, +1.6% to +3.4% above mid; EPS +3.5% to +9.2%. The stock fell from $540 (early Oct) to $349 on the Oct 13 investor day lacking a WFE number and AI-capex worries, not on fundamentals: the Q4 print beat and raised. Valuation: P/E leg 19.3x on NTM (FY28) GAAP EPS, FCF yield 2.31% on LTM levered FCF, and a normalized-earnings leg ($337) as cycle discipline; the base sits modestly above spot because the market already prices a sub-peer multiple and our CY28 path is conservative. Downside P10 is a CY28 digestion year with margin back to FY26 and a 14x trough multiple; upside P90 a Goldman-like CY28. Research was limited by the shared WebFetch budget (exhausted mid-run).
